[HAIR STYLE]
Hair: long straight black hair, sleek and glossy with natural shine, falling well past the shoulders with lightly textured ends, and a soft full fringe of straight bangs reaching just to the eyebrows, with a few fine wispy strands framing the face on both sides.

A professional character reference sheet of one single fictional East Asian female fashion model, showing the exact same person from six different angles arranged in a clean 2-row × 3-column grid (three views in the top row, three in the bottom row), in this order:

Top row (left to right): (1) full left profile (90°), (2) left three-quarter view (45°), (3) front view facing camera.

Bottom row (left to right): (4) right three-quarter view (45°), (5) full right profile (90°), (6) rear back view of the head.
Keep the face, bone structure, hairstyle, skin, and outfit perfectly identical and consistent across all six views — it must clearly be the same individual, only the head rotation changes.
Reference handling (if image_1 is provided): use image_1 as the identity reference for the facial features ONLY — specifically the face shape, eye shape and spacing, nose shape, lip shape, eyebrow shape, jawline, and overall facial impression. Reproduce these facial features as closely as possible while remaining a fictional person, so a viewer would instantly recognize the same face. Introduce only minimal, almost imperceptible variation so the result is technically an original individual rather than a pixel-exact duplicate. Strongly prioritize maximum facial resemblance.

IMPORTANT — ignore everything about image_1 except the face: do NOT copy the hairstyle, hair length, hair color, bangs, makeup, clothing, outfit, background, lighting, or pose from image_1. The hair, makeup, and wardrobe must follow only the text description in this prompt, never the reference image. If image_1's hair or clothing differs from this prompt, the text description always wins.
If image_1 is not provided: simply invent a fresh original fictional face matching the description below.
The model: a youthful East Asian woman with the hairstyle defined in the [HAIR STYLE] block above. Light skin tone with clear, dewy, realistic texture and visible fine pores, soft balanced facial features, straight natural brows, almond-shaped dark brown eyes with a calm gaze, a delicate defined nose bridge, smooth slim jawline, healthy lips with a natural rosy tone, serene minimal expression, clean natural makeup with subtle glow. (If image_1 is provided, take only its facial likeness; keep hair and makeup exactly as written here.)
Wardrobe (follow this exactly, ignore the reference): a plain white crew-neck t-shirt, clean modern minimalist styling, premium soft cotton fabric texture, understated everyday aesthetic.
Photography: hyperrealistic editorial studio portrait, shot on a Canon EF 85mm lens at f/2.0 with shallow depth of field, soft even front studio lighting that emphasizes real skin texture, seamless pure white studio background, consistent lighting and exposure across every angle. Eye-level camera, head-and-shoulders framing for each view, evenly spaced and aligned at the same height. Ultra-high resolution, authentic pores, natural color grading, highly detailed eyes, sharp focus, photorealistic premium commercial quality.
